text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I find Wonder Acute sitting by
the
stress stump.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello,
Trainer. I'm just doing a little

beadwork. It's a hobby of mine.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I quite enjoy this kind of delicate work.
And seeing how wonderful the weather
is, I thought it
would be nice to sit
outdoors.
To be, or not to be...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: To search or to concede defeat... That is the question.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do you not agree, Acute?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Dear me... I'm not sure what's going on,
but is
something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Astute as always! Will you lend
me your
ear?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As you know, I am set to star in my own

one-Umamusume opera tomorrow...
HOWEVER!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I've searched high and low, yet I'm
unable to find
a suitable stage prop.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! ...The heavens are testing me, as
Sarastro
tested the true depth of love!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A drawstring pouch! But not just any
ordinary
drawstring pouch.
choice_data_list: By the way, what are you looking for?
By the way, what are you looking for?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It must be adorned with a crown to
symbolize my standing, flames to
represent my courage, a
clover
signifying peace...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And finally, pork kimchi stir-fry to
invoke a rich
harvest! It is the Rhinegold
that I covet!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall not yield! The word "compromise"
is not to
be uttered upon my stage!
choice_data_list: I feel like the design is a bit to...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet, at this rate,
I shall have to delay my

performance until I locate the perfect
pouch...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't I make one for
you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
With a design so complicated, it would
be much
faster to make one.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I just happen to have all my
beadwork
tools right here with me.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Truly?! Then I thank you for the support
you give!
It is as if I am the Prince
Tamino, and you are
Papageno!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Wonder Acute decides to help
out T.M.
Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm finished with work for the day, and
I'm getting ready to head home when I
remember the scene
with Wonder Acute
and T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, Acute. It's as if your fingers are
being
manipulated by angels on
hiiigh! ♪
choice_data_list: I doubt they're still around by no...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet I can do naught but sing your praises
and
encouragement! How
deploooorable! ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's no trouble at all, dearie. Why, I
could keep
going all night. Do keep
singing, please.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All these custom patterns make it a
challenge,
but... we're nearly there.
choice_data_list: You were still going at it!?
You were still going at it!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And ta-dah! All finished!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! Perfection! It's exactly as I
envisioned it!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You have my eternal gratitude! I am but
a humble
servant who has been blessed
with a gift from the
goddess of creation!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This may take the form of a pouch, but it
is in fact a manifestation of the sublime
constitution of one
who relentlessly
weathers any trial!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You have my word that tomorrow's
performance will be a grand success!
Furthermore, I shall
immortalize this day
in an opera of its own!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, you certainly appear to be in high
spirits. I'd
say that makes all the effort
worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And you're absolutely right—never
giving up is
very important.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Very true. Perseverance demands a lot of stamina... Yaaawn...
choice_data_list: Make sure getting plenty of rest i...
I could learn a thing or two from ...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps we ought to return to the
dorms! I must
prepare for tomorrow's
performance as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O urges Wonder Acute on,
but I can't
quite make out her response.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Always... mngh... asleep... by this time
of...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Snore...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O and I carry the exhausted
Wonder
Acute all the way back to the
dorm.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As do I! What extraordinary
fortitude—not to
mention determination!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Your efforts must be rewarded... I know!
I shall
reserve the two of you front-row
seats for the
opera tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The performance runs four and a half
hours!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But of course. It is a full-scale opera.
You'll be sure to enjoy the exquisite
performance I deliver
with this exquisite
pouch!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why, I think that sounds swell. Thank
you, dearie.
I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our resilience will be tested
once
again—this time by watching an
extremely long
opera.
